# Skill card

<!-- Generated by tools/catalog.py from each SKILL.md's frontmatter. Do not edit. -->

Thirty-seven top-tier-engineer skills, by where the work is. Load one with the Skill
tool only on explicit request. Start with `/top-tier-engineer:drive`; specialists are
internal procedures read by file path as needed.

- **Orient:** `/top-tier-engineer:arch-map` draw the architecture or what a change does; `/top-tier-engineer:code-history` why is it built this way, who decided?; `/top-tier-engineer:explain` walk me through how this works; `/top-tier-engineer:feature-map` what can this app do, how do I reach X?; `/top-tier-engineer:onboard-system` first time in this codebase, build the whole picture; `/top-tier-engineer:project-context` ask the project's memory; `/top-tier-engineer:project-foundation` create, trace and check the project's context files, then list them; `/top-tier-engineer:project-setup` prepare agent instructions and routing; `/top-tier-engineer:recall` where were we? resume work
- **Frame:** `/top-tier-engineer:problem-framing` vague idea to testable requirements
- **Design:** `/top-tier-engineer:agent-design` design an agent's tools before any code; `/top-tier-engineer:arch-design` could the architecture be better? how should it be structured?; `/top-tier-engineer:threat-model` can this be abused?
- **Plan:** `/top-tier-engineer:issue-handoff` turn a plan into tracked issues; `/top-tier-engineer:plan-work` split work into ordered, checked slices
- **Build:** `/top-tier-engineer:agent-evals` evals and a grader before building an agent; `/top-tier-engineer:build-discipline` build a multi-file feature in proven slices; `/top-tier-engineer:evolve-maintain` upgrade, refactor or deprecate on a live system; `/top-tier-engineer:project-update` keep project memory current after work
- **Prove:** `/top-tier-engineer:agent-prove` does the agent work, over repeated runs?; `/top-tier-engineer:correctness-gate` does it actually work, before merge or release?; `/top-tier-engineer:verify-loop` check your own work until it really passes; `/top-tier-engineer:wire-check` built, but nothing happens
- **Review:** `/top-tier-engineer:latent-audit` dead code and layer violations; `/top-tier-engineer:scrutinize` second opinion on a PR, diff or plan; `/top-tier-engineer:senior-review` is this codebase good, what is the biggest gap?; `/top-tier-engineer:structure-gate` is it spaghetti, measured
- **Fix:** `/top-tier-engineer:agent-trace` why did the agent do that?; `/top-tier-engineer:debug-protocol` broken and the cause is unknown; `/top-tier-engineer:perf-optimize` slow, clunky or expensive
- **Ship:** `/top-tier-engineer:agent-release` ship an agent with kill switch and caps; `/top-tier-engineer:safe-release` deploy, or change the shape of stored data
- **Watch:** `/top-tier-engineer:agent-drift` is the live agent still what we shipped?
- **Run it for me:** `/top-tier-engineer:drive` carry a goal to done, skills chosen for you; `/top-tier-engineer:drive-overnight` the same, unattended, with a morning report; `/top-tier-engineer:pick-skill` unsure which skill fits; `/top-tier-engineer:surplus` spare budget, no goal: find real work and do it
